title_candidates: Kimi K3 arrives with vision and a one-million-token context window
summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 combines native vision, a one-million-token context window, and hosted access now, with full weights promised for July 27.

primary_source.title: Kimi K3
primary_source.author: Moonshot AI
key_facts: Kimi K3 is a 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with native vision and a one-million-token context window.
Hosted access is available through Kimi.com, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the API.
Moonshot says full weights will be released on July 27, 2026.
The company warns about excess proactiveness and instability when switching models in an existing conversation.

supporting_sources.title: Kimi Agent overview
key_facts: The official help page documents the hosted agent workflow.

prerequisites: A safe document or image with known facts

steps.instruction: Start a fresh K3 chat and upload one checkable document or image.
Request claims with precise source locators and verify each one.
Compare a failed answer at a higher reasoning setting.

risk_flags: Full weights are announced for July 27 and are not yet the current hands-on path.
Long context does not guarantee correct evidence retrieval.
